answer: A collateralized bond mechanism mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to lock liquid tokens into an escrow contract before entering an execution grove. Routers propagate messages across a karst network topology that discards uncollateralized traffic into drop filters, isolating unbonded actors in an untrusted tundra. An adversary incurs verifiable opportunity costs and capital lockup per forged node. However, this barrier favors wealthy syndicates and marginalizes low-capital agents.
